en: I warned my friend about the danger.
I didn't warn my brother early.
You warned your son yesterday.

ar: علاش ما حدرتيش السايق ديال الطوبيس
en: Why didn't you warn the bus driver?
You (f.) warned your sister in time.

ar: ما حدرتيش صاحبتك من هاد الراجل
en: You (f.) didn't warn your friend about this man.
The policeman warned the people in the street.
He didn't warn his boss.
She warned the girl about the cold.
She didn't warn her neighbor.
We warned the thief yesterday.
We didn't warn our family early.
You (pl.) warned the children at school.
Why didn't you (pl.) warn the workers in time?
They warned the neighbors about the rain.

ar: هما ما حدروش الناس من المشكل
en: They didn't warn the people about the problem.

lat: dima kan7edder sa7bi mn had sh-shi
ar: ديما كنحدر صاحبي من هاد الشي
en: I always warn my friend about this.

lat: ana ma kan7eddersh n-nas bla sebba
ar: أنا ما كنحدرش الناس بلا سبة
en: I don't warn people without a reason.
You warn my brother a lot.

lat: nta ma kat7eddersh sa7bek kul merra
ar: نتا ما كتحدرش صاحبك كل مرة
en: You don't warn your friend every time.
You (f.) always warn your sister about the cold.

lat: nti ma kat7eddrish sa7ebtek mn l-khatar
ar: نتي ما كتحدريش صاحبتك من الخطر
en: You (f.) don't warn your friend about danger.
The teacher warns the students every day.

lat: huwa ma kay7eddersh khuya mn l-kelb
ar: هو ما كيحدرش خويا من الكلب
en: He doesn't warn my brother about the dog.
Mom warns the children at home.
She doesn't warn the girl early.
We warn the people every year.

ar: حنا ما كنحدروش الجيران من المشكل
en: We don't warn the neighbors about the problem.
You (pl.) always warn the youth about danger.
You (pl.) don't warn your son.
The police warn the neighbors about theft.

lat: huma ma kay7eddrush n-nas mn l-berd
ar: هما ما كيحدروش الناس من البرد
en: They don't warn the people about the cold.

lat: ghadi n7edder khuya ghedda f s-sba7
en: I'm going to warn my brother tomorrow morning.

lat: ma ghadish n7edder l-m3ellem dyali l-yum
ar: ما غاديش نحدر المعلم ديالي اليوم
en: I'm not going to warn my boss today.

lat: nta ghadi t7edder sa7bek mn had r-rajel
ar: نتا غادي تحدر صاحبك من هاد الراجل
en: You are going to warn your friend about this man.
You are not going to warn my brother tomorrow.

lat: nti ghadi t7eddri khtek mn l-khatar
ar: نتي غادي تحدري ختك من الخطر
en: You (f.) are going to warn your sister about the danger.

lat: ma ghadish t7eddri bentek f l-weqt
en: You (f.) are not going to warn your daughter in time.

lat: l-bulisi ghadi y7edder s-sayeq f t-triq
en: The policeman is going to warn the driver on the road.

lat: huwa ma ghadish y7edder n-nas f l-7efla
ar: هو ما غاديش يحدر الناس فالحفلة
en: He is not going to warn the people at the party.

lat: hiya ghadi t7edder l-bent mn l-mushkil
ar: هي غادي تحدر البنت من المشكل
en: She is going to warn the girl about the problem.

lat: hiya ma ghadish t7edder sa7ebtha ghedda
ar: هي ما غاديش تحدر صاحبتها غدا
en: She is not going to warn her friend tomorrow.

ar: حنا غادي نحدرو العايلة ديالنا الليلة
en: We are going to warn our family tonight.
We are not going to warn our neighbor today.

lat: ntuma ghadi t7eddru l-wlad f d-dar
en: You (pl.) are going to warn the children at home.

lat: ntuma ma ghadish t7eddru l-kheddama bekri
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تحدرو الخدامة بكري
en: You (pl.) are not going to warn the workers early.

lat: huma ghadi y7eddru l-jiran mn l-ma
ar: هما غادي يحدرو الجيران من الما
en: They are going to warn the neighbors about the water.

lat: huma ma ghadish y7eddru n-nas ghedda
ar: هما ما غاديش يحدرو الناس غدا
en: They are not going to warn the people tomorrow.
